name: Yashaswini Viswanath
quote: I was at a crucial juncture in my life when I came to Malavika ma'am for a counselling session. She gave me a few tools to practice. Once I started practicing Gratitude and Thought Journalling, there was a big shift in me and I began carrying a lot of positivity towards life. With this new state, I am now very confident and getting ready to take on more responsibilities. Lots of gratitude to Malavika ma'am. Thank you.
